name: KiDS
summary: Wide-field VST / OmegaCAM survey using weak-lensing tomography to map matter structure and test cold dark matter and modified gravity.
detection_principle: Precisely measures background-galaxy distortions and photometric redshifts in multifilter images, using shear correlation functions to constrain mass clustering.

status.label: Current operational status not fully verified
status.evidence: Science data products remain public; completion of all survey data taking was not verified in this review.

results.summary: The official data page provides KiDS-1000, DES joint-shear and dark-matter / modified-gravity test products.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
